name: budget-miniapp
description: Telegram Mini App для учёта личных и семейных финансов

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@budget/api & npm run dev --workspace=@budget/miniapp & npm run dev --workspace=@budget/bot
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@budget/shared && npm run build --workspace=@budget/api && npm run build --workspace=@budget/miniapp && npm run build --workspace=@budget/bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@budget/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@budget/miniapp
